_source: Uganda Local Service Tax, employees in gainful employment: annual LST by monthly gross income. Sources: KCCA Local Service Tax FAQs (https://www.kcca.go.ug/uDocs/Local_Service_Tax_FAQs.pdf) and PwC Uganda tax data card 2025/26 (https://www.pwc.com/ug/en/assets/pdf/tax-datacard-2025-2026.pdf). Confirm with the district before approval.
_convention: Engine bands are from-inclusive, to-exclusive. Monthly gross up to and including 100,000 pays 0; 100,001 to 200,000 pays 5,000 a year; and so on. Above 1,000,000 pays 100,000 a year.
